column1: # PotluckDB math vectors: SQL that computes with floating point, and the exact result
# every platform must return. Written by make_math.py; checked on every platform by
# check_math.py and by the library's own build tests.
# Each line: SQL, a tab, then one token per result row (first column):
#   real:<16 hex digits>  an IEEE 754 double, bit for bit (sign, exponent, fraction)
#   null                  NULL (SQLite returns NULL where the math gives NaN)
#   -                     set-up: run the SQL, ignore its result
# Generated once, with seed 20261023, by PotluckDB/SQLite 0.0.0-math.1/3.54.1 on Linux x86_64.
# Results are those of the math library PotluckDB builds in, not exact values: the point
# is that every platform agrees. Regenerate only when that library changes on purpose.
WITH RECURSIVE s(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM s WHERE i<1000) SELECT sum(sin(i)*cos(i)) FROM s
WITH RECURSIVE s(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM s WHERE i<1000) SELECT avg(exp(-i/100.0)) FROM s
WITH RECURSIVE s(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM s WHERE i<1000) SELECT total(pow(i, 1.5)) FROM s
WITH RECURSIVE s(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM s WHERE i<1000) SELECT sum(ln(i)) - ln(1000) FROM s
WITH RECURSIVE s(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM s WHERE i<40) SELECT sum(sin(i)) OVER (ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM s
